subject.title: Media generation succeeds but completion delivery fails and looks like generation failure

question: Should this broad generated-media completion issue remain the canonical tracker until the open wake-false, cron-context, and output-contract follow-ups resolve, or should maintainers close it in favor of narrower trackers now?
rationale: The source and discussion show partial fixes and multiple open narrower paths, but automation cannot decide the product boundary for keeping an umbrella tracker versus splitting the remaining mechanisms.

options.title: Keep Canonical Open
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella until the open focused PRs and any output-contract follow-up are resolved or explicitly split with links back here.

options.title: Split And Close Later
options.body: Create or confirm a canonical output-contract follow-up, then close this issue only after the remaining wake-false and cron-context refs are covered by narrower issues or merged PRs.

options.title: Close To Narrow Trackers Now
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by the narrower trackers, accepting the risk that cross-mechanism context from the live reports becomes harder to find.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella until the open focused PRs and any output-contract follow-up are resolved or explicitly split with links back here.
